notes.title: Military update 10.12.2024
notes.notes:
**Game Update Summary:**  

1. **Addition of a Military Base**: A new area featuring army personnel is now accessible in the game.  
2. **Introduction of Tanks**: Tanks are available in the military base and can be used by the player.  
3. **New Cheat Code: "tank"**: Instantly spawns a tank for the player.  
4. **Army Pursuit Mechanic**: When the player reaches 6 stars or more, the army will join the pursuit to stop them.  
5. **New Armored Military Vehicle**: A sturdy and high-performance vehicle, perfect for high-risk missions, has been added to the game.  

This update enhances the gameplay with new challenges, tools, and strategies for players.

notes.title: update 03.10.2024
notes.notes:
Update: Bug Fixes and Gameplay Additions

Bug Fixes:

Fixed a bug that occasionally slowed down gofast cars.
Resolved an issue preventing civilian drug deliveries from appearing on the map.
Fixed the bug where explosives remained in hand after a hospital visit.
Resolved a bug where the arms dealer’s text would become oversized.
Fixed an issue where police cars detected weapons through walls.

Gameplay Additions and Improvements:

The police chief will only display the alert level if bribed.
Additional ranks are now awarded for successfully completing the gofast mission.
The number of followers resets after hospital visits or death.
Machine gun enemies have a slower firing rate and take more time to react.
Cars now explode.
A new crime has been added: terrorism. Planting bombs triggers enemy attacks.
Three difficulty modes added: realistic, easy, and medium.
Shooting in a vehicle no longer kills allies.

notes.title: Patch 26.09.2024
notes.notes:
Here are the new features added to your game:

Earnings Rebalance:

You will now be able to earn 3 times more money during missions and activities. This will allow you to progress faster and climb the gang ranks with additional resources.

Passive Income:

Based on your rank in the gang, you will now receive regular passive income. The higher your rank, the more significant this income will be, encouraging you to rise through the ranks and maintain a position of power.

New Gofast Mission:

A new gofast mission has been added, available from the officer rank. The goal is to deliver drugs by car to a hideout while avoiding law enforcement.

Police Chief - Benefits if Paid:

If you bribe the police chief, you will have several advantages:

You can remove one star from your wanted level every day, reducing police pressure on your activities.
You will receive information about SWAT raids targeting your gang.
These additions bring more strategic depth to the game, giving you greater control over your income and police threat management. Use this to increase your influence in the gang and amass wealth!

notes.title: What's comming next in Gangs of the Street ?
notes.notes:
The game has been improved, and many bugs have been fixed. The game is ambitious, which requires a lot of work. Thank you to those who trusted me and bought the game while it was still unfinished. I have a lot of ideas for the game, but they take time to implement. The time invested also needs to match the game's success and whether it interests many people.

I initially wanted to create an ultra-realistic game, but I realized that making a game too realistic can kill the fun. For example, I think the player currently doesn’t earn enough money when completing activities, which prevents them from hiring characters. The game also lacks missions for climbing the ranks of the gang before becoming the leader.

Here are the things I will implement:

Rebalancing the game to allow players to earn more money (x3).
Giving the player passive income based on their rank in the gang.
Adding a gofast mission for drug delivery by car, available at the sergeant rank.
If the player has paid the police chief, they can remove one star every day.
If the player has paid the police chief, they get information about SWAT raids targeting the gang.

Things that might be implemented depending on the game's success:

The possibility to buy a helicopter for quick travel and to avoid police control.
Expanding the map to the south.
The possibility of hosting parties in residences and selling drugs at a higher price.
A new gang available in the southern part of the map (mystery gang).

notes.title: update 22.09.2024
notes.notes:
We've added several exciting new features to the game with this update:

The police investigation level is now only displayed if the Chief of Police is corrupt.
If the player has bribed the Chief of Police, they will receive 2 stars instead of 3 when escaping from prison.
When delivering drugs to a hideout, the amount delivered will be deducted from the player's debt to the gang. If there is no debt, the surplus is converted into cash. This works with all vehicles.

Voice lines have been added for most characters to enhance immersion.

notes.title: update 19.09.2023
notes.notes:
Update: New Adjustments!

Police Detection: Cops no longer detect the player’s attacks through walls.

Banks: Bugs related to jewelry and bank vault money have been fixed. The player can now properly collect the money after delivering it to the hideouts.

Businessman: The businessman's guards will only attack the player after they have read the text, not before.
Thank you for your support and enjoy the game!

notes.title: update note 18.09.2024
notes.notes:
New update available!
In this version, new mechanics and bug fixes have been added to enhance the gameplay experience:

SWAT Members: They will appear if the gang commits too many infractions. If you don't eliminate them, they will capture the Montanas' hideouts after some time.
Bug Fixes:
Fixed display issues related to weapon pickups.
All bugs related to bomb usage have been resolved.
Inventories are now updated after loading the game.
Bratva cars can despawn properly.

Various text display and bulletproof vest purchase bugs have been fixed.

Bratva Attacks: If animosity between the Bratvas and Montanas is high, the Bratvas can attack the Montanas' hideouts. The player will have the chance to react in time to prevent it.

Drug Distribution: It is no longer possible to give drugs to Bratvas who are following the player.
Miscellaneous: Many other bugs have been fixed for smoother gameplay.
Thank you for your patience and enjoy the game!

notes.title: Update Notes parch 12.09.2024
notes.notes:
Patch Notes:

New Language Support: A new language has been added, and the code structure is optimized to add more in the future. Players can request new languages.

Police Alert System: The police chief can now provide an alert level.

Civilian Reactions: Civilians now change direction when the player tries to sell them drugs.

Vehicle Fixes: Issues with the directions of Rinini and taxi cars have been resolved.

Debt Payment: The player cannot pay their debt if they lack funds, and more time is given to repay.

Countdown Bug Fixes: Bugs with the businessman and police chief countdowns have been fixed.

Time Adjustment: One real-life minute now equals one hour in-game.

Variable Resets: Several variables (e.g., businessman debt, police chief corruption) now reset upon the player’s death and are saved during the game.

Payments: Businesses, the casino, and hideouts now process payments every 24 in-game hours.

Enemy Shooting Fix: Enemies no longer shoot through roofs, and bullets no longer pass through them.
Radio Positioning: The radio’s position is saved, preventing the same music from playing when the game is reloaded.

Businessman Attack: The player is attacked when they hit the businessman.
Player Death: When the player dies while wearing a specific outfit, the appropriate body now appears.

notes.title: update 23.08.2024
notes.notes:
If the player corrupts the boss's right-hand men, they remain corrupted even if the player saves and returns 🔄.

Montanas following the player can now attack the hitmen's bodyguards 💥.

Bratva will not attack the player if shot at from a distance 🚫🔫.

No more framerate drops when the player is behind a barrier and being followed by the police 🎮✨.

The higher the police alert level, the more patrol officers there will be - Initially, there will be fewer police on the streets 🚓.

Fixed collision bugs with furniture 🛋️.

notes.title: update 20.08.2024
notes.notes:
Update Changes:

🚔 Police now attack all gang members who shoot, not just the player.

🚗 Special Bratva vehicles filled with drugs will now spawn in the Bratva gang hideouts.

💰 Debt can now be repaid with Bratva's cocaine, as long as it's in a Montana vehicle.

🔫 A screen shake effect has been added when the player fires weapons.

❌ If the player kills a civilian they sold drugs to, the contact will be removed.
💰💥 Characters now drop money, weapons, and ammunition when they die.
👥⚠️ If the player kills gang members with an equal or higher rank and there are witnesses, they will be attacked.
🚗🎨 Cars now come in different colors.

notes.title: update 14.08.2024
notes.notes:
🚚 Fixed Bugs in the Game:

📦 Removed Vehicle Inventory Messages: No more revealing what's in the vehicle's inventory when it's delivered! 🚗

🔓 Access to Drug Truck Inventory: Players can now access the inventory of the drug truck. Keep your operations smooth! 💊

💸 Money Laundering Bug: Fixed a bug where laundering money became impossible after saving. Now, your money can flow cleanly again! 🧼💰

💼 Drug Delivery After Save: Allies will still deliver cash to the player even if they save, quit, and come back after giving drugs to an ally. The money will always find its way! 💵

❌ No Money, No Laundering: Fixed a bug that allowed players to launder money even if they had none. Now, you'll need actual cash to do that! 😅

notes.title: Update 13.08.2024
notes.notes:
💰 Increased Cash Collected When Attacking Shops: The amount of cash collected from attacking shops has been increased to 1000 / 10,000. More rewards, more fun!

🔄 Reset Player Debt on Respawn: Player debt is now reset upon respawn, giving you a fresh start every time.

⌨️ Changed Keyboard Layout to QWERTY (English): The keyboard layout has been switched to QWERTY (English) for a smoother experience.

📋 Added Gameplay Instructions: New hints and tips have been added to help you master the game!

🎨 Modified UI Element Placement: Several UI elements have been repositioned for a cleaner and more intuitive interface.

Enjoy the new features and happy gaming! 🎮✨

notes.title: Update notes from july 2024.
notes.notes:
🌆👋 Hello, citizens of Gang City!

I am very happy to announce this new update that corrects some bugs and adds a few things to the game. Here is the list of the most important changes:

🆕 Update:

🐛 Bugs/Fixes:
🚶‍♂️ Increased the distance at which the player can speak to citizens.
🚗 Put the car names in the right place.
🗺️ Fixed a bug that made the map disappear after a certain time.
🚆 Fixed a bug that made the player unable to board the train.
🦵 Fixed a bug that made the player’s legs move when he is dead.

✨ Added Features:

📱 Added the new smartphone and the possibility to change the wallpaper from the phone.
🔔 Receiving sound notification when receiving a message.
🚗 Added more car slots at the car dealerships.
🩸 Made the blood disappear after a certain time.
⏳ Increased the time before dead bodyguards disappear, even if the player is far away.
🖥️ Added the possibility to play in full screen and change the screen size.
⏲️ Increased the timer for drug delivery to civilians.
📝 You can now choose your name.
ℹ️ Added indications for all interactions, which you can change in the menu.
👣 Added noise for footsteps.

Enjoy the new features and fixes! 🎮🚀
